comments.author: kkostenkov
comments.body: So it's a chess game with skill elements? Amazing! Every time I see a chess variation game I'm falling in love. However the the audience for this combination might be quite small, don't you think?

replies.author: Another__one
replies.body: I am not planning to release it unless it goes viral or something like that. I just had a random thought that it would be a funny combination and vibe-coded it in an hour or two yesterday evening, made a video and called it a day. I could make a website later hosting it, but again don't really see much sense in it unless there is a demand for it, and again anybody could copy it pretty easily. Why bother?

replies.author: kkostenkov
replies.body:
Up to you my friend. But imo believing that someone would copy your game on our scale is the same ambitious thought as thinking that the game goes viral. Unlikely for the majority of devs.  
And no, I'm not nudging you to publish it. Just take my respect for the result you got in several hours.

replies.author: Another__one
replies.body:
I mean even if I host it there is no real monetization path, but I will have to pay for hosting itself, so it's gonna be net negative. And even if I will figure out monetization somehow, it is too easy to copy to seriously rely on it.

I have been making flash games back in 2010-ish, and even back then it was quite a challenge to make any good money on them. And now it is even more comically difficult, therefore not really worth spending any extra time.

replies.author: kkostenkov
replies.body:
Host on itch. It's free and could help you sharing the link with someone easily. However they started chasing AI slop recently so be careful.  
Sometimes it's not about the monetization but the portfolio if thats could be relevant to you. However once again, Im not nudging you to publish it.
